True for session/difficulty pairs marked as repeated in config.

Screen height saved with calibration; used to normalize y.

Actual camera height reported in session summary, not requested height.

Original last held-out validation decision; blank if absent. Not an input to window tier assignment.

Last held-out P95 error of point mean predictions; not a frame-level error quantile.
Last held-out maximum corner error.
Operational completeness/clipping tier; good does not certify spatial accuracy or mental-state validity.

Blink count * 60 / full window duration; partial recordings can undercount, see coverage.
